inicio.descricao: Project preparation, cost management and construction management for renovations, houses and apartment buildings. STOA Management, Farvagny-le-Grand, canton of Fribourg.

realisations.descricao: The projects and references of STOA Management, a construction management office in Farvagny-le-Grand.

contact.descricao: A renovation, a house or an apartment building? Write to STOA Management or give us a call.

heroi.subtitulo: Preparation, coordination and follow-up of your building works.

apresentacao.titulo: Renovations, houses, apartment buildings. We prepare the project, track the costs and run the site.
apresentacao.paragrafo1: STOA Management is a construction management office based in Farvagny-le-Grand, in the canton of Fribourg.
apresentacao.paragrafo2: From structural work to finishing, we coordinate how the project unfolds and step in where needed.
apresentacao.paragrafo3: More than ten years in this field have given us solid knowledge and a sense of priorities.

destaque.intro: A selection of projects, from excavation to façade.

especialidades.intro: Three skills, from the project to the site.

preparacao.resumo: Preliminary design, planning application, construction drawings, building costs, tenders.
preparacao.detalhe: Everything decided before the site opens: the project takes shape, permits are applied for, costs are estimated and contractors are consulted.

financas.resumo: Monitoring and control of construction costs.
financas.detalhe: Costs are tracked throughout construction, so that every decision is made knowing its effect on the budget.

direcao.resumo: Coordination and intervention as the project unfolds.
direcao.detalhe: On site, construction management organises the contractors’ work, follows progress and steps in when a decision is needed.

metodo.intro: Construction management is built in order.
metodo.aviso: Draft text, to be approved by STOA.

compreender.texto: The project, the site, the budget and your expectations.

coordenar.texto: The contractors, the schedule and the decisions to be made.

acompanhar.texto: Progress, execution and costs, on site.

entregar.texto: Acceptance of the works and closing of the site.

equipa.intro: The people who follow your building works.
equipa.aviso: Profiles pending: photos and details to be provided by STOA.

chamada.texto: Renovation, house or apartment building: tell us about your project and we will get back to you.

immeuble-balcons-filants.resumo: Aerial views of a four-storey building with continuous balconies, on the edge of a village.

relato.projeto: A residential building on the edge of a village, for <lacuna>client</lacuna>. Four storeys, with continuous balconies running the full length of the façade.
relato.obra: STOA <lacuna>exact role on site</lacuna>. Contractors, schedule and costs are coordinated in one place, from structural work to finishes.
relato.entrega: Handover <lacuna>date</lacuna>. From the air, the building settles into the edge of the village.

immeuble-village.resumo: Aerial view of a three-storey building, between houses and sports grounds.

relato.projeto: Three storeys between houses and sports fields. A building of <lacuna>number</lacuna> homes, built for <lacuna>client</lacuna>.
relato.obra: On a plot surrounded by neighbours, organising the site matters as much as the construction. <lacuna>What STOA took on</lacuna>.
relato.entrega: Handover <lacuna>date</lacuna>. The building has found its place in the neighbourhood.

chantier-immeuble.resumo: Aerial views of a building site in a residential area, from the foundations to the structure.

relato.projeto: A building in a residential area, for <lacuna>client</lacuna>. The site was photographed from the air, stage by stage.
relato.obra: From foundations to structure, the same views return and show the progress. It is what site management follows every day: deadlines, execution, costs.
relato.entrega: Next stage <lacuna>to be specified</lacuna>. The series of images continues until handover.

villas-mitoyennes.resumo: A group of terraced houses between meadow and forest, seen from the sky.

relato.projeto: A group of semi-detached houses between meadow and forest, for <lacuna>client</lacuna>. <lacuna>Number</lacuna> homes, one architectural language.
relato.obra: Several houses, one site. Work moves from one house to the next, and site management keeps the pace of the whole.
relato.entrega: Handover <lacuna>date</lacuna>. The houses open onto the meadow, with the forest behind.

immeuble-facades-panneaux.resumo: A three-storey building: the solar roof seen from the sky, the façade seen from the ground.

relato.projeto: A three-storey building, for <lacuna>client</lacuna>. Panel façades, a roof covered in solar panels.
relato.obra: A panel envelope demands precision at every joint. <lacuna>STOA’s role and key moments on site</lacuna>.
relato.entrega: Handover <lacuna>date</lacuna>. From the ground, the façade. From the air, a roof that produces energy.

terrassement-fondations.resumo: A plot seen from the sky, from earthworks to the first foundations.

relato.projeto: A plot, before the building. <lacuna>What is being built</lacuna> for <lacuna>client</lacuna>.
relato.obra: Earthworks, then the first foundations. The aerial views record what will no longer be visible once the building stands.
relato.entrega: <lacuna>Next stage or handover date</lacuna>. Everything that follows rests on these first stages.

immeuble-facades-rosees.resumo: A five-storey building and its surroundings under construction.

relato.projeto: A five-storey building with pink façades, for <lacuna>client</lacuna>.
relato.obra: The building stands; the surroundings are still under way. That is often where the end of a project is decided: landscaping, junctions, finishes.
relato.entrega: Handover <lacuna>date</lacuna>. A building is handed over when its surroundings are too.

immeuble-toiture-vegetalisee.resumo: A building with a green roof and solar panels, in a residential area.

relato.projeto: A building in a residential neighbourhood, for <lacuna>client</lacuna>. On the roof, planting and solar panels share the surface.
relato.obra: <lacuna>STOA’s role</lacuna>. A roof carrying both planting and energy is coordinated across several trades, down to the last waterproofing upstand.
relato.entrega: Handover <lacuna>date</lacuna>. Seen from above, the building’s fifth façade.

maison-toiture-tuiles.resumo: A three-storey house with a tiled roof and balconies on the façade.

relato.projeto: A three-storey house, for <lacuna>client</lacuna>. Tiled roof, balconies on the façade.
relato.obra: At the scale of a house, every decision shows. <lacuna>STOA’s role and how the project unfolded</lacuna>.
relato.entrega: The house is handed over to its owners <lacuna>date</lacuna>.

batiment-activites.resumo: A commercial building with a solar roof, in an industrial area.

relato.projeto: A commercial building in a light-industrial zone, for <lacuna>client</lacuna>. A solar roof, volumes designed for work.
relato.obra: A commercial building is often built to tight deadlines. <lacuna>STOA’s role, site constraints</lacuna>.
relato.entrega: Handover of the premises <lacuna>date</lacuna>. <lacuna>Key takeaway from the project</lacuna>.

transformation-arconciel.resumo: Conversion of an apartment in Arconciel, where Leandro Lopes managed the works.

relato.projeto: The renovation of an apartment in Arconciel, in 2020. <lacuna>Nature of the work</lacuna>.
relato.obra: Leandro Lopes manages the works, in collaboration with Georges Hayoz. In an existing building, each demolition is decided after seeing what lies behind.
relato.entrega: Handover of the apartment <lacuna>date</lacuna>. <lacuna>What the renovation changed</lacuna>.

quartier-villas-chesopelloz.resumo: Construction management of a housing estate in Chésopelloz.

relato.projeto: A neighbourhood of houses in Chésopelloz, in 2015. <lacuna>Number</lacuna> homes, for <lacuna>client</lacuna>.
relato.obra: Site management in collaboration with Formul’habitat, in Bulle. A neighbourhood is built house by house, and the schedule is held at the scale of the whole.
relato.entrega: Handover of the houses <lacuna>date</lacuna>. <lacuna>Key takeaway from the mission</lacuna>.

immeuble-ppe-noreaz.resumo: Site and construction management of a building in Noréaz.

relato.projeto: A condominium building in Noréaz, in 2017. <lacuna>Number</lacuna> apartments.
relato.obra: Site and works management, in collaboration with Archi-Thèmes, in Vaulruz. In a condominium, each buyer makes their own choices, and the site integrates them without losing the thread.
relato.entrega: Handover of the apartments <lacuna>date</lacuna>. <lacuna>Key takeaway from the mission</lacuna>.

quartier-villas-corminboeuf.resumo: Housing estate in Corminboeuf, where Leandro Lopes assisted the construction management.

relato.projeto: A neighbourhood of houses in Corminboeuf, built from 2016 to 2021. <lacuna>Number</lacuna> homes.
relato.obra: Leandro Lopes assists the site management, in collaboration with Roya Immobilier, in Villars-sur-Glâne. Over several years, a neighbourhood is built in stages, and each stage prepares the next.
relato.entrega: Handover of the last houses <lacuna>date</lacuna>. <lacuna>Key takeaway from the mission</lacuna>.
